name: Open Hikmah
one_liner: A web app that lets you explore Qur'an verses as a connected graph on an infinite canvas, with AI explaining each link.

text.why: Reading linearly makes it hard to see how verses relate. Open Hikmah lets you place a verse on a canvas and expand related verses by root word, theme or contrast.
text.take: Every edge links to its explanation.
build: Candidates come from shared Arabic roots and embedding similarity; the AI only explains why a link holds and never invents a reference. Search by reference (2:255), keyword or meaning, share a canvas as one URL, and play audio.

who.role: People who study the Qur'an by theme or root.

start.text: Open openhikmah.com, search a verse and place it on the canvas.

caveat: Licensed GPL-3.0. The AI explains a religious text, so treat its explanations as aids, not authoritative interpretation, and check the source. Some features appear to need a login [to be confirmed].

license.scope_text: Use freely. Release your source if you redistribute (copyleft).

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.

notes: This file was produced by the same build, from the same data, as the tesign.com item page. The text is editorial; the numbers are stored observations.
